description: [Daba Finance] Heirs Energies Ltd, a company controlled by Tony Elumelu, has acquired 6 million ordinary shares in Seplat Energy Plc. The transaction is valued at £53.2 million. Seplat Energy disclosed the new share purchase in a regulatory filing on Thursday, signed by Edith Onwuchekwa, the company's Director, Legal/Company Secretary.
title: Africa: Heirs Energies Boosts Seplat Energy Stake to 21 Percent

description: [Africa CDC] Kinshasa -- The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) welcomes and supports the position of the Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, expressed through the Ministry of Public Health, Hygiene and Social Welfare, to strengthen transparency, traceability and accountability in the management of resources mobilised for the Ebola response.
title: Africa: Africa CDC Supports DR Congo in Strengthening Transparency and Accountability in Ebola Response Funding
